name: Google Gemini Embeddings API
rate_limits: Free tier: 100 RPM and 1,000 RPD for embeddings. Note: Dec 2025 quota reductions applied (50-80% cuts to free tier). Not available for EEA/Switzerland/UK-serving apps on free tier.
notes: Google's embedding models via Gemini API. Models: gemini-embedding-001 (text, stable) and gemini-embedding-2-preview (multimodal: text, images, video, audio, PDFs). Flexible output dimensions: 128-3072 (recommended: 768, 1536, 3072). API key obtained from Google AI Studio. Free tier suitable for prototyping and small-scale RAG experiments. Critical for AI self-improvement: high-quality embeddings for semantic search, similarity matching, RAG systems, clustering, and classification. Batch API available at 50% cost for higher throughput. Free tier data may be used for model improvement by Google.
